description_short: Smart electric power governor. Demand-driven load shedding with in-game priority (P10->P1) and recipe output targeting.
description_long: Power Threshold Governor (v1.1.0) An intelligent electrical load-shedding and power management system for Captain of Industry. Protect your factory from catastrophic blackout death spirals by automatically pausing heavy consumers during power shortages, and smoothly bringing them back online in controlled stages. Key Features: • ⚡ Building Types Tab: Configure pause permissions for entire machine categories (e.g. Arc Furnaces, Computing Data Centers, Research Labs). • 📦 Recipe Outputs Tab: Target machines by what product they are actively producing (e.g. Steel, Molten Iron, Silicon, Fertilizer), regardless of recipe variant (e.g. Steel from Scrap, Crushed, or Iron Ore). • 🎯 In-Game Priority Load Shedding: When power demand outpaces supply, the governor sheds machines in priority order—Priority 10 first, stepping down to Priority 1 last. Critical machines remain running! • 🛡️ Stepped Grid Restoration: Sophisticated blackout loop prevention. When power recovers stably, machines are safely revived one by one in reverse priority order (Priority 1 first, ramping up to Priority 10). • 📊 Live Island Telemetry: Displays real-time counts of built machines and their live power draw alongside maximum capacity (e.g. 36 MW / 81 MW). • ⏸ Paused Buildings Tab: Detailed overview of all currently throttled machines showing active output products, priorities, and one-click camera focus or bulk resume. • 🔧 Local Inspector Overrides: Click any machine to set instance-specific governor exemptions or overrides. • 🖱️ Easy Access: Accessible via top HUD power button, Alt + P, or F8. Compatible with vanilla saves — safely added to or removed from existing saves at any time.
